scheme_name: Saphalam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Kerala.
Must have secured admission in merit seats in government, aided or self‑financing colleges.
Eligible courses include MBBS, Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSc), BSc Agriculture in government colleges, and any diploma‑level government‑accredited professional courses.
For applicants aged 18 years or above, a copy of the Transgender ID card must be submitted.
For applicants below 18 years, a self‑declaration statement certified by the Head of Institution or parent must be submitted.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹1,00,000 per year in financial assistance for transgender students pursuing degree or diploma professional courses.
documents_required: Self‑declaration statement certified by Head of Institution/Parent
